data.name: InstallerTagline
data.value: Build and maintain your installation with the same dark KM experience.

data.name: InitializingDescription
data.value: Starting the KM Editor installation engine.

data.name: DetectingDescription
data.value: Looking for an existing KM Editor installation and determining the correct update path.

data.name: ReadyInstallDescription
data.value: KM Editor will be installed for your Windows account. Any old editor cache will be cleared while your settings are kept.

data.name: ReadyMaintenanceDescription
data.value: You can repair KM Editor or remove it from this PC. Uninstall always clears editor cache; deleting settings is optional.

data.name: ReadyUpdateDescription
data.value: The verified update is ready. It will replace the application and clear editor cache while keeping your settings.

data.name: ReadyRecoveryDescription
data.value: KM Editor is missing files or has incomplete setup records. Repair and reinstall will write the current version from this installer, preserve your settings, and restore this setup as the maintenance owner.

data.name: ReadyMigrationDescription
data.value: Setup verified the existing installation and will transfer it to the new repairable installer. Editor cache will be cleared and your settings will be kept.

data.name: PlanningInstallDescription
data.value: Windows Installer is calculating the files and registration needed to install KM Editor.

data.name: PlanningUpdateDescription
data.value: Windows Installer is calculating the changes needed to update KM Editor safely.

data.name: PlanningRecoveryDescription
data.value: Windows Installer is verifying the recovery source and calculating the files and ownership to restore.

data.name: PlanningRepairDescription
data.value: Windows Installer is determining which KM Editor files and registrations need repair.

data.name: PlanningUninstallDescription
data.value: Windows Installer is calculating the application files, editor cache, and registration to remove.

data.name: CachingInstallDescription
data.value: Checking the installer payload and staging the files required to install KM Editor.

data.name: CachingUpdateDescription
data.value: Checking the verified update payload and staging the replacement files.

data.name: CachingRecoveryDescription
data.value: Checking the setup payload and staging the complete package needed to repair and reinstall KM Editor.

data.name: CachingRepairDescription
data.value: Checking the installer payload before restoring KM Editor.

data.name: CachingUninstallDescription
data.value: Verifying the registered installation before removing KM Editor.

data.name: ExecutingInstallDescription
data.value: Copying application files, registering KM Editor, and clearing old editor cache. Your settings are being kept.

data.name: ExecutingUpdateDescription
data.value: Replacing application files and clearing editor cache while keeping your settings.

data.name: ExecutingRecoveryDescription
data.value: Restoring the complete application package and its installer ownership while keeping your settings.

data.name: ExecutingRepairDescription
data.value: Verifying installed files and restoring anything that is missing or damaged.

data.name: ExecutingUninstallDescription
data.value: Removing application files and editor cache. Settings are removed only if you selected that option.

data.name: FinalizingInstallDescription
data.value: Completing registration and final checks for the new installation.

data.name: FinalizingUpdateDescription
data.value: Completing registration and cleaning up superseded installer data.

data.name: FinalizingRecoveryDescription
data.value: Completing the recovered installation registration and final checks.

data.name: FinalizingRepairDescription
data.value: Completing registration and final verification of the repaired installation.

data.name: FinalizingUninstallDescription
data.value: Completing cache cleanup and removing the remaining installer registration.

data.name: InstallingDescription
data.value: Installing application files and registering KM Editor.

data.name: UpdatingDescription
data.value: Applying the verified update. KM Editor will reopen when the update is complete.

data.name: RepairingDescription
data.value: Verifying installed files and restoring anything that is missing or damaged.

data.name: UninstallingDescription
data.value: Removing installed application files and registration.

data.name: CancellingDescription
data.value: Waiting for Windows Installer to reach a safe rollback point.

data.name: InstallSuccessDescription
data.value: Installation completed successfully. Old editor cache was cleared and your settings were kept.

data.name: UpdateSuccessHeading
data.value: KM Editor is up to date

data.name: UpdateSuccessDescription
data.value: The update completed successfully. Editor cache was cleared and your settings were kept.

data.name: RecoverySuccessDescription
data.value: KM Editor files and installer ownership were restored successfully.

data.name: UninstallSuccessDescription
data.value: KM Editor and its editor cache were removed successfully.

data.name: FailureDescription
data.value: No success state was recorded. Review the details or open the installation log before trying again.

data.name: CancelledDescription
data.value: Windows Installer stopped and rolled back the incomplete change.

data.name: BlockedDescription
data.value: No changes were made. Review the existing installation details below.

data.name: ExistingInstallConflictDescription
data.value: KM Editor has conflicting, incomplete, or unsafe installation ownership. Setup will not install, update, or repair until that state is resolved. Uninstall is offered only when setup can prove the exact registered custom installation.

data.name: NewerInstallDescription
data.value: A newer version of KM Editor is already installed. Setup will not replace it with an older version.

data.name: UnknownFailure
data.value: Windows Installer returned an unexpected error.

data.name: RelaunchWarning
data.value: The update installed successfully, but KM Editor could not be reopened automatically.

data.name: RestartRequiredNotice
data.value: Windows must be restarted to finish this change. You can restart now or finish and restart later.

data.name: RestartRequiredManualNotice
data.value: Windows must be restarted to finish this change. Finish setup, then restart Windows when you are ready.

data.name: StatusPlanningRecovery
data.value: Calculating the repair and reinstall plan

data.name: StatusExecutingInstall
data.value: Installing files and clearing old editor cache

data.name: StatusExecutingUpdate
data.value: Updating files and clearing editor cache

data.name: StatusExecutingUninstall
data.value: Removing KM Editor and editor cache

data.name: StatusCancelling
data.value: Waiting for a safe point to stop

data.name: DeleteUserSettingsLabel
data.value: Also delete my KM Editor settings

data.name: DeleteUserSettingsDescription
data.value: Leave this unchecked to keep your preferences, saved paths, and other editor settings. Rebuildable editor cache is always removed.

data.name: InvocationBridgeFailure
data.value: The updater handoff data was invalid. Setup stopped before planning any changes.

data.name: FatalBootstrapperFailure
data.value: KM Editor Setup could not start its installation interface. No success was recorded; review the setup log or try a fresh installer download.

data.name: ShortcutPreferenceFailure
data.value: Setup found an invalid saved shortcut preference and stopped before planning changes.
